result.reason: The redline fixes the software duration and removes the premature sunset, but it does not reach the full playbook position. It lacks a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty and compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code warranty remains limited to code that was willfully introduced. It also applies a single 12-month period triggered by acceptance of the Software to both the Software and MarketSite.net Service, rather than using the specified services period, making the change broader and less precise than necessary. The correction/replacement/refund framework is generally retained, although refund remains conditioned on termination and inability to correct.
